topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe you're moving! It's like, the whole world just got a bit bigger, you know? I’ve been trying to think of all the adventures you're about to have, and my mind’s just bursting with all the possibilities. New people, new places, and you, shining bright in the middle of it all. I’m already scheming our next get-together, maybe a road trip or a surprise visit? This is just the beginning, and we’re just getting started. There’s so much to explore and talk about. I’m so excited for you, and I can’t wait to hear every single detail!
